section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study that investigated the moderating role of self-compassion on the relationship between body-related threats (body comparison and appearance contingent self-worth) and body appreciation. The study involved an online sample of 263 women with a mean age of 35.26 years. Results indicated that self-compassion moderated these inverse relationships, suggesting it helps preserve women's body appreciation during body-related threats.
